segments.text: The repository looks like a joke: the README says it is just an empty file, and there is nothing interesting in the working tree.
I log in as bandit30 with ssh bandit30@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
The lab blocks the localhost ssh hop, so I clone from this client.
I open the README: just an empty file, muahaha.
But git stores more than files and commits: tags are separate references, so I list them.
There is a single tag named secret.
Showing that tag prints the password for bandit thirty-one, and the level is solved.
